summary: Nex Core now configures the Nex APT repository out of the box (BUG-0042). The nex-core-local package ships the dearmored Nex archive signing key at /usr/share/keyrings/nex-archive-keyring.gpg and the postinst writes /etc/apt/sources.list.d/nex.sources (deb822, Signed-By the key, URIs from repo_url in /etc/nex/updates.conf); the prerm removes it on removal. Previously nex.list.example was shipped as an example only and never installed, so apt update listed only Debian repos. API impact: none.

guide.reason: Software updates prerequisites now state that a fresh host preconfigures the Nex APT source so apt update lists the repo; clarifies that apt is separate from the in-product Update flow.

api.reason: Packaging/host configuration change only; no Controller/Core or client-facing API is added or changed. The apt repository and its signing key already exist and are published.

verification.method: python3 -m unittest tests.test_core_local_package (postinst writes the deb822 nex.sources with Signed-By and repo_url-driven URI; package ships the dearmored keyring; prerm removes the source and never deletes guest/state); the committed key was verified against the live repo InRelease with gpgv. Run in both GitHub and Gitea phase1 workflows via test_*.py discovery.
